title: Find the subintervals
text: Here $$f(x)=sin^2\left(\pi x\right)$$. The width of each subinterval is $$\frac{1-0}{3}=\frac{1}{3}$$. The midpoints of the subintervals are $$\frac{1}{6}$$, $$0.5$$ and $$\frac{5}{6}$$.

title: Apply the rule
text: Compute $$M_3=\frac{1}{3} \left(f{\left(\frac{1}{6}\right)}+f{\left(0.5\right)}+f{\left(\frac{5}{6}\right)}\right)$$, which comes out to about $$0.5$$.
